ashrei/en.primary_text: Fortunate are they that dwell in Thine House, they will still praise Thee, Selah. Fortunate the people to whom this happens, fortunate the people whose God is the Lord. Hymn by David I exalt Thee, my God and King, and bless Thy Name for ever and ever. Every day do I bless Thee and praise Thy Name for ever and ever. Great is the Lord and highly to be praised, His greatness is unfathomable. Generation shall praise Thy works to generation and they shall tell of Thy mighty deeds. The beauty of the glory of Thy majesty and words about Thy wonders shall I utter. Men shall speak of the strength of Thine awe-inspiring deeds and, as for Thy greatness, let me relate it. The fame of the abundance of Thy goodness do they express and exult in Thy righteousness. Gracious and compassionate is the Lord, long suffering and great in kindness. Benevolent is the Lord towards all and His compassion is upon all His creatures. All Thy works acknowledge Thee, O Lord, and Thy pious ones bless Thee. They speak of the glory of Thy dominion and tell of Thy might to make known to the sons of man His mighty deeds and the glory of the beauty of His dominion. Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom and Thy dominion is in every generation. The Lord supports all that fall and straightens all that are bent. All eyes hope for Thee and Thou givest them their food in its time. Thou openest Thy hands and satisfiest all the living in favour. Righteous is the Lord in all His ways and pious in all His deeds. The Lord is near all who call Him, all who call Him in truth. The desire of those that fear Him does He do and He hears their cry and saves them. The Lord protects all that love Him and destroys all the wicked. The fame of the Lord does my mouth declare and all flesh shall bless His holy Name for ever and ever. We too shall bless the Lord from now to eternity. Halleluyah.

psalm_92/en.primary_text: A psalm, a song for the Sabbath day: It is good to thank the Lord and to sing praise to Thy Name, O Most High, to proclaim Thy kindness in the morning and Thy faithfulness at night, on the ten-stringed harp, through meditation on the zither. For Thou hast gladdened me, O Lord, with Thy deeds, in the works of Thy hands do I exult. How great are Thy works, O Lord, profound indeed are Thy thoughts. A simpleton cannot know, nor can a fool understand this, when the wicked flourish like grass and all evil-doers blossom forth only to be destroyed for ever. But Thou art supreme to eternity, O Lord. Behold Thine enemies, O Lord, behold Thine enemies shall perish, all evil-doers shall scatter. Then shalt Thou lift up my horn like the unicorn, I am anointed with fresh oil. Then shall my eye look down upon my adversaries, when evil men rise up against me my ears shall hear. The righteous shall flourish like the palm, like the cedar on Lebanon shall he grow. Those planted in the House of the Lord shall blossom forth in the courts of our God. They will yet be luxuriant in old age, full of sap and fresh will they be, so as to proclaim that the Lord is upright, my Rock in whom there is no wrong.

Thy throne is established from of old, since eternity art Thou. The streams, O Lord, the streams have raised their voice, the streams shall raise their roar. morning_ashrei/en.primary_text: Fortunate are they that dwell in Thine House, they will still praise Thee, Selah. Fortunate the people to whom this happens, fortunate the people whose God is the Lord. Hymn by David I exalt Thee, my God and King, and bless Thy Name for ever and ever. psalm_147/en.primary_text: Halleluyah. For the Lord is good, sing to our God for He is pleasant, praise is becoming. The builder of Jerusalem is the Lord, the dispersed of Israel will He gather together. It is He who heals the broken-hearted and binds their wounds. He counts the number of the stars and calls all of them by name. Great is our Lord, abundant of power, His understanding is beyond measure. A supporter of the humble is the Lord, He casts down the wicked to the ground. Respond to the Lord with gratitude, play to our God upon the harp. He who covers heaven with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on mountains, He gives the beast its food, to the young ravens when they call out. He delights not in the might of the horse nor takes pleasure in the legs of a man. The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear Him, in those who wait for His grace. Extol the Lord, O Jerusalem, praise your God, O Zion. For He has strengthened the breaches of your gates, He has blessed your children in your midst. Peace has He placed in your border and satisfied you with rich wheat. He sends forth His command upon the earth, very swiftly does His word run. He grants snow like wool and scatters frost like dust. He hurls down His ice like morsels of bread, who can stand before His cold. He sends His word to melt them, causes His wind to blow and water flows. He tells His words to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel. He did not do this to any other nation, they do not know His judgments. Halleluyah.

psalm_148/en.primary_text: Halleluyah. Praise the Lord from the heavens, praise Him in the high places. Praise Him, all His angels, praise Him, all His hosts. Praise Him, O sun and moon, praise Him all stars of light. Praise Him, O highest heavens, O water above the heavens. Let them praise the Name of the Lord for He commanded and they were created. He established them for ever, for eternity, He gave a decree that will not pass. Praise the Lord from the earth, dragons and all the depths. Fire and hail, snow and smoke, the whirlwind obeys His order, the mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars, the wild beast and all cattle, reptiles and winged birds, earthly kings and all nations, princes and all earthly judges, youths as well as maidens, old men with young lads. Let them praise the Name of the Lord for His Name alone is exalted. His majesty is above earth and heaven. He has raised the condition of His people, there is fame for all His pious ones, for the children of Israel, the people near Him, Halleluyah.

psalm_149/he.primary_text: הַלֲלוּיָהּ שִׁירוּ לַיהֹוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּתוֹ בִּקְהַל חֲסִידִים: יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֹשָׂיו בְּנֵי־צִיּוֹן יָגִילוּ בְמַלְכָּם: יְהַלֲלוּ שְׁמוֹ בְמָחוֹל בְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לוֹ: כִּי־רוֹצֶה יְהֹוָה בְּעַמּוֹ יְפָאֵר עֲנָוִים בִּישׁוּעָה: יַעְלְזוּ חֲסִידִים בְּכָבוֹד יְרַנְּנוּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם: רוֹמְמוֹת אֵל בִּגְרוֹנָם וְחֶרֶב פִּיפִיּוֹת בְּיָדָם: לַעֲשׂוֹת נְקָמָה בַגּוֹיִם תּוֹכֵחוֹת בַּלְאֻמִּים: לֶאְסֹר מַלְכֵיהֶם בְּזִקִּים וְנִכְבְּדֵיהֶם בְּכַבְלֵי בַרְזֶל: לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם מִשְׁפָּט כָּתוּב הָדָר הוּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו הַלֲלוּיָהּ:

psalm_149/en.primary_text: Halleluyah. Sing unto the Lord a new song, His fame is in the gathering of the pious. Israel rejoices in its Maker, the sons of Zion exult in their King. Let them praise His Name with dancing, with timbrel and harp let them play to Him. For the Lord favours His people, He adorns the humble with victory. The pious revel in honour, they exult upon their couches. Exaltations of God are in their throat and a two-edged sword in their hand, so as to carry out vengeance among the nations, chastisements among the peoples, to bind their kings in fetters and their notables in chains of iron, to execute on them the judgment that is written. He is an adornment to all His pious ones. Halleluyah.

psalm_150/he.primary_text: הַלֲלוּיָהּ הַלֲלוּ־אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ הַלֲלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ: הַלֲלוּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָיו הַלֲלוּהוּ כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ: הַלֲלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר הַלֲלוּהוּ בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר: הַלֲלוּהוּ בְתֹף וּמָחוֹל הַלֲלוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעֻגָב: הַלֲלוּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־שָׁמַע הַלֲלוּהוּ בְּצִלְצְלֵי תְרוּעָה: כל הַנְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ הַלֲלוּיָהּ:
psalm_150/he.independent_text: הַֽלְלוּיָהּ הַֽלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ הַֽלְלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ: הַֽלְלוּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָיו הַֽלְלוּהוּ כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ: הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר: הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְתֹף וּמָחוֹל הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעֻגָב: הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־שָׁמַע הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְּצִלְצְלֵי תְרוּעָה: כל הַנְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ הַֽלְלוּיָהּ:

psalm_150/en.primary_text: Halleluyah. Praise God in His sanctuary, praise Him in His strong firmament. Praise Him for His mighty deeds, praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness. Praise Him with the Shofar’s blast, praise Him with zither and harp, Praise Him with timbrel and dance, praise Him on string instruments and flute. Praise Him with the clash of cymbals, praise Him with the ring of cymbals. Let all with breath praise the Lord, Halleluyah.

barukh_adonai/he.primary_text: בָּרוּךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן: בָּרוּךְ יְיָ מִצִּיּוֹן שֹׁכֵן יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם הַלֲלוּיָהּ: בָּרוּךְ יְיָ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת לְבַדּוֹ: וּבָרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְעוֹלָם וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹדוֹ אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ אָמֵן וְאָמֵן:
barukh_adonai/he.independent_text: בָּרוּךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן: בָּרוּךְ יְיָ מִצִּיּוֹן שֹׁכֵן יְרוּשָׁלָםִ הַֽלְלוּיָהּ: בָּרוּךְ יְיָ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת לְבַדּוֹ: וּבָרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְעוֹלָם וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹדוֹ אֶת־כֹּל הָאָרֶץ אָמֵן וְאָמֵן:

barukh_adonai/en.primary_text: Blessed be the Lord for ever Amen and Amen. Blessed be the Lord from Zion, He who dwells in Jerusalem, Halleluyah. Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone performs wonders, and blessed be His glorious Name for ever and let all the earth be filled with His glory, Amen and Amen.
